headline: 9 Avalon Labs contracts catalogued on Ethereum from Etherscan name-tag search; no dedicated SuperEarn vault contract or docs page located; AVL governance token, USDa OFT, staking, multisig, and deployer EOA surfaced.

findings.text: Etherscan name-tag search surfaced: USDa Token (0x8a60e489…), Avalon Labs Deployer EOA (0xd955f0c1…), AVL Staking (0x2c9B3D4e…), sAVL Token (0xdb8d7761…), AVL Token (0x5c8d0c48…), a Safe 1.4.1 multisig (0x74e878f4…) receiving execTransaction calls from deployer, plus proxy 0x04Ce218e and relay 0xAcdDAC6C seen in USDa internal transactions. Two Avalon aToken contracts (0xc6ab82fc and 0x2e6500a7) also surfaced in deployer token holdings.
Protocol website (https://app.avalonfinance.xyz/earn) returned geo-restricted HTML with no contract addresses. No deployed-contracts doc page was discoverable in this run.
No audit_links provided in protocol context. No audit PDFs discovered via website or search in this run.
No GitHub org/repo was recorded in protocol context. No GitHub repo discovered in this run via search or website.
Protocol.chains lists only Ethereum; DeFiLlama also shows TVL on Movement chain (~$30M) but Movement is not in the supported chainId list for this run. Ethereum-only discovery performed.
No factory contract surfaced. AVL Staking at 0x2c9B3D4e appears to be a single staking contract, not a factory. Cap notice not triggered.

Role taxonomy applied: USDa Token (token), AVL Token (token), sAVL Token (token), AVL Staking (other/staking), Deployer (admin/EOA), Safe multisig (multisig), proxy 0x04Ce218e (other/proxy), relay 0xAcdDAC6C (other/bridge-relay), aTokens (other/yield-token).

All addresses in admin_addresses[] trace to fetched Etherscan pages in this run. The specific SuperEarn yield vault/strategy contract on Ethereum was not located — only the USDa stablecoin and AVL governance ecosystem were found. This is a critical gap for the SuperEarn yield product assessment.

rationale.verdict: Corpora walked: Etherscan name-tag search (D1), protocol website (D2, blocked), no GitHub (D4), no audits (D3). 9 Avalon Labs ecosystem contracts catalogued on Ethereum; the specific SuperEarn vault/strategy/yield contract was not located. Protocol is categorised as Yield but the on-chain yield mechanism contract remains undiscovered this run.

protocol_metadata.about: Avalon Labs is a Bitcoin-focused CeDeFi platform that allows users to borrow against BTC-derivative collateral and earn yield through its SuperEarn product. SuperEarn targets 8–15% annual returns by combining quantitative trading strategies, DeFi yield opportunities, and tokenized real-world asset (RWA) exposure. The platform issues USDa, a LayerZero OFT-enabled stablecoin deployable across multiple chains, and uses an AVL governance token with a staking mechanism (sAVL). The dominant TVL concentration as of this run is on the Movement chain (~$30M), with minimal Ethereum TVL ($1.2).
